sources.title: Mark Lund and Zhuan Ye, Nevanlinna theory of meromorphic functions on annuli

contents.name: Definition A: exterior counting, proximity, and characteristic
contents.note: The local statement fixes normalized circular means explicitly; the paper’s displayed proximity integral omits 1/(2π), so its boundary FMT is not used as a normalization black box.

contents.name: Theorem A1: first main theorem on a genuine exterior domain
contents.note: For a nonconstant meromorphic function near {0<ρ0≤|z|<∞}, finite target ω, the stated error is O(log ρ); the authors attribute this to the fixed positive inner radius. The local proof derives the normalized form directly from annular Jensen and displays the fixed-circle winding term.

contents.name: Theorem A2: exterior logarithmic-derivative estimate
contents.note: Same one-sided exterior-domain hypothesis; m(R,F′/F)=O(max(log+T1(R,F),log R)) outside E of finite linear measure in exterior radius R. The local proof first makes all selected targets finite by a Mobius map whose pole avoids both the targets and the fixed inner-circle image, then applies A2 to G and each G-c_j; finite unions preserve finite measure.

contents.name: Fixed-inner-radius error explanation for Theorem A1
